name: print-social-supplement-infographic-and-black-friday-banner-system
title: Blue vitamin infographics, hydration pouch listing images and Black Friday banners with hang tags
whatItIs: A tall sheet with nine square infographic cards in royal and pale blue (nutrient chart, gap grid, floating gummies, pouch and stick packs, ingredient callouts, how-to steps), then desktop and mobile shop pages with 'BLACK Friday' hang-tags, 47% badges, snowy hero photos and product rows.
whatItMeans: Clear and trustworthy; consistent blue and simple icons make science approachable.
techniques: Explain benefits with callouts pointing at the pack.
Use icon lists for steps and ingredients.
Frame sale banners with a hang-tag title.
Show desktop and mobile of the same promo.

vocabulary.definition: A label pointing at a product feature.
A title in a price-tag shape.
An image in an e-commerce product gallery explaining features.
A scalloped badge stating a discount.
